symptom: Powerhouse appeared structurally connected in repository intent while live production still contained unmaterialized decision-cycle, economics, outcome and connector evidence gaps.
root_causes: Repository capability and production persistence were previously conflated.
Historic assumptions about exact schema names can become stale and must be checked against information_schema and canonical migrations.
Queued CI is a delivery-capacity state, not a code defect.
Configured or available providers are not equivalent to persisted source evidence or verified outcomes.
New quality-critical functions/RPC surfaces must be registered in the canonical quality-surface registry before the discovery gate can accept them.
recovery: Continue only PR #2023 for this obligation.
Use the existing structural-gap and unified-data-spine migrations rather than creating duplicate authorities.
Materialize legacy sales actions only to truthful signal-stage decision cycles.
Require later stages, economics, feedback and realized value to arrive from observed evidence.
Converge GA4, GSC, LinkedIn, Instagram, Buffer transport, external intelligence, DataForSEO and portal state through canonical evidence/runtime authorities.
Allow exact-head Required and BRAIN gates to produce the first concrete failure before changing code.
After protected merge, apply production migrations/functions and verify counts, source freshness, schedules and runtime health before closing.
Register every newly discovered function/RPC surface in config/powerhouse-quality-surface-contracts.json with an existing executable evidence contract before rerunning the same exact-head gate.
